reading.zh: 从左到右：消息经接入与感知进入话题会话，表达层按反思预设与社交画像生成回复，并依赖记忆与基础设施；箭头表示依赖方向。panel 是横切的观测面板，读运行时快照，不参与消息流。
reading.en: Left to right: messages flow through gateway and perception into topic sessions; expression generates replies using reflection presets and social portraits, relying on memory and infrastructure. Arrows show dependency direction. panel is the cross-cutting observability front end reading runtime snapshots; it is not part of the message flow.
